name: Optimizing liquid for fastest execution and parsing

description: v4 investigator strictness/retry/validation/fallback update; reran 18 Iliad prompts and captured q1-q18 outputs

asi.hypothesis: Stricter answer contract plus entity validation and fallback synthesis would reduce malformed or unsupported Qwen answers while keeping evidence-grounded outputs.
asi.observation: In this environment, vector retrieval fell back to lexical mode and Qwen did not return direct answers, so every run used the evidence-based fallback path.
asi.next_step: Re-run when the vector/LLM backend is available to measure the acceptance path and retry behavior.

description: v5 embedding-dimension fix for retrieval; reran 18 Iliad prompts with vector search restored

asi.hypothesis: The main slowdown and quality loss came from a mock/real embedding dimension mismatch causing vector retrieval to fail and fall back to lexical search.
asi.observation: Changing the mock fallback embedding dimension to match the stored 768-d vector index restored vector retrieval for all 18 prompts and cut runtime substantially.
asi.next_step: If Ollama remains unavailable, consider a graceful no-LLM synthesis mode; otherwise re-test the direct-answer path with Ollama online.
asi.benchmark_safety: Used the persisted Iliad prompt set without altering questions or answers.

description: v6 Ollama availability cache for investigator; reran 18 Iliad prompts with LLM branches skipped when offline

asi.hypothesis: Caching Ollama availability and skipping repeated follow-up/answer attempts when offline would reduce runtime without changing benchmark inputs or retrieval behavior.
asi.observation: The cache skipped LLM work on all 18 prompts and reduced runtime further to 1.36s while preserving the same grounded fallback outputs.
asi.next_step: If a live Ollama becomes available, re-run to verify the direct-answer path still passes validation; otherwise continue improving no-LLM synthesis quality.
asi.benchmark_safety: No prompt changes; only avoided redundant offline connection attempts.

description: v7 cached reading assets and index/page reuse; reran 18 Iliad prompts with repeated disk loads removed

asi.hypothesis: Repeated loading of the same index/pages/summary context per question was the remaining runtime bottleneck after caching Ollama availability.
asi.observation: Caching reading assets and reusing the loaded vector index/pages cut runtime to 289,234µs while preserving the same benchmark behavior.
asi.next_step: If quality work resumes, focus on making no-LLM fallback answers more informative; for speed, this cache path seems near diminishing returns.
asi.benchmark_safety: No benchmark changes; only removed repeated file/index reloads on the same reading.
